{"path": "fade.py", "content": "from gpiozero import PWMLED
from signal import pause
# Manual software PWM flickers because the Python loop timing is not deterministic.
# Hardware PWM0 is on BCM12; gpiozero uses lgpio hardware-timed PWM on the Pi 5.
led = PWMLED(12)
led.pulse()  # smooth hardware-backed fade
pause()
"}

text: Fixed: manual software PWM flickered because the loop timing is not deterministic on a non-realtime kernel. Drive the hardware PWM0 pin (BCM12) with gpiozero PWMLED(12), which uses lgpio hardware-timed PWM on Pi 5.
